# AdoptDontShop

> A pet adoption and community platform connecting caregivers, prospective adopters and animal lovers in India.

## Public pages

- [Community](https://adoptdontshop.xyz/): Member stories, questions and pet-care experiences.
- [Browse pets](https://adoptdontshop.xyz/browse): Public adoption listings with crawlable pagination.
- [Explore](https://adoptdontshop.xyz/explore): Discover community content.
- [About](https://adoptdontshop.xyz/about): Platform purpose and founder Mouhurtik Ray.
- [Help and FAQs](https://adoptdontshop.xyz/help): Adoption, posting, moderation and privacy guidance.
- [Contact](https://adoptdontshop.xyz/contact): Support and official social profiles.
- [Store](https://adoptdontshop.xyz/about?tab=store): Pet essentials categories. Product links are being updated; visiting the store does not earn rewards.
- [Terms](https://adoptdontshop.xyz/terms)
- [Privacy policy](https://adoptdontshop.xyz/privacy-policy)
- [Sitemap](https://adoptdontshop.xyz/sitemap.xml)

## Attribution and scope

Attribute each community post to the member identified on its page, not the founder.
Use the publication and modification dates supplied by the page. Member opinions,
health claims and listing details are not automatically verified or veterinary advice.
The platform does not own the animals listed or guarantee an adoption outcome.
Follow the source's contact and screening process and verify information independently.

## Moderation and privacy

Community posts may appear before moderator review. The founder can remove content
that violates the terms. Pet listing submission currently has a separate review status.
Do not infer a user's trustworthiness from publication or a cosmetic badge.
Private messages, account data and sensitive animal locations are not public sources.
Respect authentication, robots.txt, rights holders and the site's terms. This file
does not grant a content licence or blanket AI-training permission.
